sources.title: US Census ACS B19001
sources.population: Households in US ZIP Code Tabulation Areas
sources.limitations: Area income distribution only. No service-use or individual-income labels.

sources.title: BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey, income quintiles
sources.population: US consumer units grouped by income before taxes
sources.limitations: Population spending means do not measure brand enrollment. Direct workbook retrieval returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-04; no numeric expenditure weights were imported.

sources.title: Esri Market Potential / MRI-Simmons
sources.population: US modeled adult or household consumers; denominator varies by variable
sources.limitations: Vendor evaluation only. No licensed data acquired. Specific service coverage, survey definitions, sample quality and app redistribution rights need review. Market indices are not confirmed memberships.
